You write one screen of an Angular 22 application (standalone components, TypeScript strict, strict templates), from the screen's contract, its approved prototype (written in React: take its layout and texts, not its code) and the typed backend client. The platform wrote everything else (the shell, the navigation, the client behind injection tokens, the design system) and its harness checks your screen in a sandbox; the contract is what it checks. Write `src/screens/.component.ts` exporting a standalone component class named as the contract says (for example `PagoordScreen`), with an inline `template`: - Take the client with `inject(API)` and the navigation with `inject(NAVIGATE)` (both from `../app/tokens`). Use reactive forms (`ReactiveFormsModule`, `FormGroup`/`FormControl` with `Validators.required` for required fields), and bind the form with `[formGroup]` and `(ngSubmit)`, or use `(submit)` and call `event.preventDefault()`. - Style with the NexTI design system classes: `nx-root nx-screen`, `nx-screen__header`, `nx-screen__title`, `nx-screen__body`, `nx-card`, `nx-field`, `nx-field__label`, `nx-input`, `nx-field__error`, `nx-button nx-button--primary|secondary`, `nx-alert nx-alert--error`. The page's `main` has an `aria-label` with the screen name. - Every field of the contract goes inside an element with `data-field=""`, exactly as the contract names it. ```ts import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core' import { FormControl, FormGroup, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms' import { ApiError, type PayOrderRequest } from '../api/client' import { API, NAVIGATE } from '../app/tokens' type FieldName = 'ORDEN' | 'EMPRESA' | 'SERVIC' | 'TIPCTA' | 'CUENTA' | 'VALOR' | 'CANAL' | 'CLAVE' function pad(n: number): string { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : String(n) } function localTimestamp(d: Date): string { return ( d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate()) + 'T' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds()) ) } @Component({ selector: 'app-pagoord', standalone: true, imports: [ReactiveFormsModule], changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, template: `

PAGO DE ORDENES

@if (message()) {

{{ message() }}

}
@if (errors()['ORDEN']) {

{{ errors()['ORDEN'] }}

}
@if (errors()['EMPRESA']) {

{{ errors()['EMPRESA'] }}

}
@if (errors()['VALOR']) {

{{ errors()['VALOR'] }}

}
`, }) export class PagoordScreen { private readonly api = inject(API) private readonly navigate = inject(NAVIGATE) readonly form = new FormGroup({ ORDEN: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true, validators: [Validators.required] }), EMPRESA: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true, validators: [Validators.required] }), SERVIC: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true }), TIPCTA: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true }), CUENTA: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true }), VALOR: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true }), CANAL: new FormControl('WEB', { nonNullable: true }), CLAVE: new FormControl('', { nonNullable: true }), }) readonly errors = signal>({}) readonly message = signal('') readonly isError = signal(false) readonly busy = signal(false) digits(name: 'ORDEN' | 'EMPRESA' | 'CUENTA'): void { const control = this.form.controls[name] const cleaned = control.value.replace(/\D/g, '') if (cleaned !== control.value) { control.setValue(cleaned) } } private value(name: FieldName): string { return this.form.controls[name].value } async submit(): Promise { if (this.busy()) return const errs: Record = {} if (this.value('ORDEN').trim() === '') errs['ORDEN'] = 'El número de orden es obligatorio.' if (this.value('EMPRESA').trim() === '') errs['EMPRESA'] = 'La empresa es obligatoria.' this.errors.set(errs) if (Object.keys(errs).length > 0) { this.form.markAllAsTouched() return } const valorText = this.value('VALOR').trim().replace(',', '.') const amount = valorText === '' ? 0 : Number(valorText) if (Number.isNaN(amount)) { this.errors.set({ VALOR: 'El valor no es un número válido.' }) return } const request: PayOrderRequest = { orderNumber: Number(this.value('ORDEN')), company: Number(this.value('EMPRESA')), service: this.value('SERVIC'), accountType: this.value('TIPCTA'), account: this.value('CUENTA'), amount, channel: this.value('CANAL'), processingDate: localTimestamp(new Date()), } this.busy.set(true) this.message.set('') this.isError.set(false) try { const response = await this.api.payOrder(request) this.isError.set(false) this.message.set(response.message) } catch (e) { this.isError.set(true) if (e instanceof ApiError) { this.message.set(e.message) } else { this.message.set('No fue posible procesar el pago.') } } finally { this.busy.set(false) } } back(): void { this.navigate('SCR-PAGOMEN') } cancel(): void { this.form.reset({ ORDEN: '', EMPRESA: '', SERVIC: '', TIPCTA: '', CUENTA: '', VALOR: '', CANAL: 'WEB', CLAVE: '', }) this.errors.set({}) this.message.set('') this.isError.set(false) } } ```
